confirmedIssues: Blocker F-01 remains supported: when a closed chunk's source-turn projection goes stale, refreshClosedChunkFromSourceTurns downgrades only conversationTranscript and leaves chunk.lowerBand untouched (src/thread/async-thread/services/chunk-service.ts:464-488). getReadyChunkLowerBandArtifact still treats those lower-band artifacts as ready based only on their own status/text (src/thread/async-thread/domain/chunk-state.ts:83-97), strict readiness/compact code still consumes that helper (src/thread/async-thread/services/async-thread-run-service.ts:975-984; src/thread-view/services/thread-view-builder.ts:317-320), and the passing regression test still asserts transcript pending while both lower-band artifacts stay ready (tests/thread/sqlite-maintenance-row-level.test.ts:395-399). This still violates the transcript-invalidation/readiness contract behind AC-4.5 and the AC-5 lower-band compact requirements.

Non-blocking NB-01 remains supported: the migration input still publishes sourceThreadDir and targetDbPath (src/thread/migration/sqlite-thread-migration-service.ts:29-34), but buildMigrationSnapshot ignores sourceThreadDir and always opens the legacy thread from rootDir/threadId (src/thread/migration/sqlite-thread-migration-service.ts:304-316). Import seeding honors targetDbPath (src/thread/migration/sqlite-thread-migration-service.ts:511-542), while operational SQLite reads still resolve only threads/<threadId>/thread.sqlite (src/thread/store/sqlite-thread-store.ts:632-646, 996-1026).
disputedOrUnconfirmedIssues: Prior blocker F-02 is no longer supported by the current code. The active first message_end auto-create path now creates the thread, attempts capture, and rolls the thread back on capture/map/reopen failure (src/context-steward/pi/pi-extension.ts:1813-1854), and the current regression test proves a forced first-append failure leaves findManagedThread(target) undefined before a later successful retry (tests/context-steward/runtime-capture-sqlite.test.ts:317-343).
result.readinessAssessment: Not ready for closeout. On May 26, 2026, the targeted regression suites passed and npm run verify-all passed, and the earlier first-capture transactional blocker is now fixed, but the stale lower-band readiness defect still remains in the production code and is still codified by a passing test.
result.recommendedNextStep: Fix the closed-chunk invalidation path so transcript non-ready status also downgrades or clears detailed and brief lower-band artifacts, update the regression expectation in tests/thread/sqlite-maintenance-row-level.test.ts, and rerun the targeted maintenance/compact coverage plus npm run verify-all.
